question: A train overtakes two persons who are walking at 15 m/s and 35 m/s, respectively, in the same direction as that of the train in 20 seconds and 40 seconds. respectively, the length of the train is:
solution:
**Given:**

The speed of 1st person = 15m/s

The speed of 2nd person = 35m/s

Time taken to overtake the 1st person = 20 seconds

Time taken to overtake the 2nd person = 40 seconds

**Formula:**

Speed = Distanceover Time

**Calculation:**

 When two bodies move in the same direction, then 

Relative Speed = Difference of their speeds 

Let the length and the speed of a train be L and V respectively. 

speed of 1st person = 15m/s

speed of 2nd person = 35m/s

Relative Speed of the train and the first person = (V -15) m/sec

⇒ V - 15 = Lover20

⇒V =Lover20 + 15 -----(1)

Relative speed of the train and the second person = (V - 35) m/sec

⇒V - 35 = Lover40

⇒V = Lover40 + 35 -----(2)

Equating equation (1) and equation (2),

⇒ Lover20 +15 = Lover40 + 35 

⇒ Lover20- Lover40 = 35 -15

⇒Lover40 = 20

⇒L = 800m 

** The length of the train is ' 800m'.**
